name: Free Bait
text: Your armed bait is not used up. Its Allure still counts.

name: Sweet Tooth
text: +25% Allure, so rarer elves show up more.

name: Cosy Mittens
text: No pillage on an escape: nothing is stolen.

name: Starfall
text: Rare elves, mini bosses and bosses are twice as likely to show up.

name: Full Sack
text: Loot drops x2 and every catch drops at least one material.

name: Mulligan
text: An escape is rolled again once; the better result counts.

name: Santa's Blessing
text: A huge trap power boost (x2.5). Strong gear and the right power type still matter.

name: Boss Bell
text: The next hunt meets this area's boss (or its strongest mini boss).

name: Cheer Surge
text: Meter pips from catches x2 and escapes cost nothing.
